programme.desc: Richie & Seth call a truce & work together to find Malvado's headquarters. Carlos abducts Santanico & claims her for himself. Kate enlists Freddie's help as she attempts to save her brother.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Following the trail of the mass grave, Freddie & Kate uncover an epic secret & find themselves trapped in the cellar of Oculto, one of the more reclusive & dangerous Lords of the Night.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Richie & Seth hatch a plan to complete Santanico's revenge & walk away with the score of a lifetime. Freddie & Kate find themselves facing an unexpected foe after Malvado's attack.
programme.sub-title: Bring Me the Head of Santanico Pandemonium

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: As the pieces of the big job fall into place, the uneasy trust between brothers and partners crumbles in the light of betrayals and new loyalties.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Santanico confronts Malvado with Seth's help, while Richie and Kate must stop Carlos and Scott from overturning the ancient prophecy and taking control of a powerful evil.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Seth and Santanico clash with Richie over his betrayal, while Carlos and Scott aim to take Malvado's empire and unleash culebra frenzy on the world.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.

programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: Andromeda: Bunkernkulle
programme.desc: Dylan och hans nya flotta från Samväldet tar sig an Drago-Kazovs flotta men finner den mycket större än väntat.

programme.title: Andromeda: Ouroboros
programme.desc: Magog-äggen i Harper börjar kläckas, så teamet bygger en Teseract-maskin.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lava och raketer
programme.desc: Dylan tar över en turistbåt i ett försök att undkomma legosoldater.

programme.title: Andromeda: Var alla mina synder ihåg
programme.desc: En identifiering av en kropp går snett när det visar sig att Bekas tidigare besättningskamrat inte är död.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dans av majflugor
programme.desc: Andromeda räddar döende människor från en drivkraft, men de förvandlas snart till zombies som styrs av en hivemind.

programme.title: Andromeda: I himmelrik finns nu tre
programme.desc: Skapelsens motor kan skriva om universum enligt ägarens önskemål. Dylan, Beka och Trance måste få tag på den innan någon med mörka planer får tag på den.

programme.title: Andromeda: Saker som vi inte kan ändra på
programme.desc: Ett svart hål slår ut Dylan och skickar honom till en alternativ verklighet med fru och barn.
programme.sub-title: Saker som vi inte kan ändra på

programme.title: Andromeda: The Fair Uknown
programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en av de sedan länge försvunna grundarna av Samväldet, men upptäcker att hon kan vara mer besvärlig än vad hon är värd.

programme.title: Andromeda: Odjurets mage
programme.desc: Ett mytologiskt rymdmonster försöker äta Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Riddaren, döden och djävulen
programme.desc: Dylan försöker befria en flotta av tillfångatagna skepp, men flottan är inte säker på att den vill bli befriad. Deras AI:er fruktar att nya kaptener kommer att förslava dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Obefläckad varseblivning
programme.desc: Geniter attackerar Tyrs fru och koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tunneln i slutet av ljuset
programme.desc: Med femtio partier ombord är Dylan värd för undertecknandet av stadgan för det nya samväldet, men upptäcker snart att det finns inkräktare som är fast beslutna att stoppa undertecknandet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Om hjulet är fast
programme.desc: Beka och Tyr tas över av energin från en dimensionell tunnel. Dylan, Trance och Harper måste rädda dem innan de förstör skeppet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rimnis skärvor
programme.desc: Dylan blir anklagad för mord och måste rentvå sitt namn samtidigt som han hittar delarna till en vas som sägs ge ägaren "kosmos välsignelser".

programme.title: Andromeda: Galet att bli räddad
programme.desc: Besättningen räddar en grupp flyktingar, men upptäcker att de har utsatts för regeringsexperiment och är extremt instabila.

programme.title: Andromeda: Cui Bono
programme.desc: Bekkas farbror kandiderar till ett ämbete i det nya samväldet, men ett mordförsök får besättningen att agera som hans säkerhetsvakt.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den ensamma och jämna sanden
programme.desc: När Andromeda attackeras av rymdpirater räddas de av ett sedan länge försvunnet rymdskepp från jorden.

programme.title: Andromeda: Slipfighter det krigshundarna
programme.desc: Besättningen upptäcker att en oseriös planet, Marduk, har skapat massförstörelsevapen.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den Lepers kyss
programme.desc: En torped vid namn Leper har ledarna för det nya samväldets ledare som måltavla.

programme.title: Andromeda: För vem klockan ringer
programme.desc: Andromeda hemsöks av en mystisk varelse som kommer ombord under en solstorm.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Feet
programme.desc: In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: At the scene of a vicious murder, the killer went to a great deal of effort to wipe away his fingerprints and obscure his shoe impressions left when he tracked blood trails on the floor.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Interrupted
programme.desc: On May 12, 1994, Crystal Perry was viciously murdered in her home in Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, 32, was later found guilty in the slaying.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Runaway Love
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Little Secret
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery. The evidence found solves a brutal crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club, but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Disappearance of Helle Crafts
programme.desc: In the series premiere of "Forensic Files", the longest-running true crime series in history, a Connecticut flight attendant goes missing. Police suspect her husband is guilty of murder, but can they prove it?

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Magic Bullet
programme.desc: A fifteen-year-old boy dies from a mysterious gunshot wound to the head while sitting in the lobby of his father's gun club. Ballistics, laser technology, made-to-scale models and the latest in forensic animation are used to find the cause.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The House That Roared
programme.desc: A woman disappears and her husband becomes the prime suspect — especially after police find a huge bloodstain on the carpet of their bedroom. When they spray the bedroom with Luminol, they discover it was awash with blood spatter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Planted Evidence
programme.desc: One morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovers the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled and possibly raped. Nearby plants tell investigators more about the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Wilson Murder
programme.desc: On the night of May 22, 1992, Betty Wilson returned home after a meeting and discovered her husband lying in a pool of blood. Jack Wilson had obviously been murdered — but how?

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Southside Strangler
programme.desc: Timothy Wilson Spencer was identified as the man who raped and strangled five young women in Virginia. With the use of DNA profiling, an innocent man is freed and the real killer is convicted.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Legionnaires' Disease
programme.desc: After a Philadelphia Convention, 180 Legionnaires contract pneumonia-like symptoms and 29 of them die. The determination of one scientist helps identify the cause of this deadly disease.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The List Murders
programme.desc: In 1971, John List left a note with the bodies of his mother, wife and three children in his mansion ballroom before disappearing completely. Detectives must solve the case, despite having only an outdated photograph of List.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Dirty Deed
programme.desc: In this classic episode of Forensic Files, the longest-running true crime series in television history, Eileen and Derrick Severs disappear from their home in a small village in Great Britain and police find evidence of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Fog
programme.desc: It was the single most deadly automobile accident in American history. Almost a hundred vehicles were involved, twelve people died and more than fifty people were injured. And it happened along a stretch of highway long known for dense, thick fog.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sex, Lies and DNA
programme.desc: While vacationing in California, Earl Morris learns that his wife has gone missing from their Arizona home. The search for Ruby Morris involves dozens of investigators and scientists — and even the Coast Guard.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Charred Remains
programme.desc: Shortly after daybreak, a fire is started in a dumpster in Vancouver. No one sees the arsonist or the fire, which burns for hours in the deserted parking lot. But there's more than garbage in this flaming container.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Postal Mortem
programme.desc: On October 15, 1985, two bomb explosions rocked Salt Lake City and resulted in two deaths. A third explosion occurred the next day; this time, the victim survived.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Micro-Clues
programme.desc: After a day of fishing in a quiet village in Switzerland, a teenage boy doesn't return home as planned. The investigation reveals some important microscopic evidence in the water near where he was last seen.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Broken Vowes
programme.desc: When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness
programme.desc: George Orwell's concept of Big Brother remains in the realm of fiction. But as technology becomes more a part of our lives, it's becoming increasingly more difficult to make a move without leaving behind an electronic trace.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bad Medicine
programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Soldier Stories
programme.desc: This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Price of Murder
programme.desc: Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Taste of Poison
programme.desc: Poisoners are the most devious of killers, relying on stealth or their victim's trust in order to steal their lives. They're the most dangerous creatures in the world: smart assassins. And they usually don't stop at one kill.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner Investigator
programme.desc: CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Youths
programme.desc: A young girl playing in her yard in Spokane, Washington suddenly vanishes. In St. Louis, another girl leaves to visit a friend. She never arrived.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Partners In Crime
programme.desc: They say that a burden shared is a burden halved, but when partners team up to commit murder, the weight of their guilt remains just as heavy. Investigators must rely on forensic science to capture partners in crime.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Demons on The Buses
programme.desc: Hidden in St Helens, is a museum that is home to demonic and dark entities trapped inside of vehicles.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Jack The Ripper
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head to Sefton and investigate a police station connected to the murderous Jack The Ripper. Was James Maybrick really the Ripper? Did his wife poison him?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: House of Horror
programme.desc: Blackpool is iconic for ghosts and tonight, Sean and Bex investigate a horror attraction which appears to have attracted some very real spirits that are spooking its customers.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Scars for Life
programme.desc: Could a tattoo studio be haunted? Has a Ouija board opened a gateway to the spirit dimension? Ghost Dimension spend the night investigating Deviant Ink tattoo studio.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Hotel of Horror
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension heads to Halewood and investigates the Wellington Hotel, believed to be a hive of paranormal activity. Will they uncover what is haunting this public house?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Who is There?
programme.desc: Could a cemetery be haunted? The team come head out to find out and contact restless souls that have been haunting the graveyard.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Man with a Cane
programme.desc: The team head to Bolton and investigate the Old Three Crowns. Haunted by the spirit of a very angry man with a deadly cane and an upset, young, ghostly girl, will they uncover why the girl is so upset? And could they encounter the angry spirit man?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: I Hear a Baby Crying
programme.desc: The team investigate the Market Hotel in Bolton. Believed to be haunted by the lost soul of a previous landlord and a guest who likes to make herself known. They make contact with spirits from the other side and witness first hand paranormal activity.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: Halloween Special
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: The House of The Devil
programme.desc: The island of Gran Canaria houses some of the most haunted buildings in the world and tonight the team fly to the island and investigate claims of satanic worship and paranormal activity in a house that is believed to have been built by the Devil himself

programme.title: Ghost Dimension: House of Fear
programme.desc: Located in Gran Canaria, there is one house that locals refuse to enter and that is, The House of Fear. Ghostly shadows, loud banging and demonic voices have all been reported here and the Ghost Dimension team will investigate these claims tonight.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 1
programme.desc: Many urban explorers have encountered paranormal activity inside of the building, including child like figures, unexplained voices and strange knocking sounds. Will anything from the ghost dimension make contact?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Norris Green Mansion Part 2
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate Norris Green Mansion. A 17th Century building, which is believed to hold some of the most haunted spirits in Liverpool. Will they make contact its ghostly entities tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: House of Hauntings
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean head to New Mills and investigate a home situated on the grounds of death and destruction from the bombings of WW2. Will any of the spirits lost in this disaster come forward and make contact during the investigation today?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Haunted Crank Caves
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate some of the most haunted caves systems in the world. Crank Caves. Located in St Helens, myths and legends surround this labyrinth of tunnels and the team seek out paranormal claims of ghostly activity

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Halloween Special Chillingham Castle
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension's Bex and Sean investigate Chillingham Castle for a Halloween investigation. The most haunted castle in the world. Reports of paranormal activity are daily here, so what will the team manage to capture tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Poltergeist House
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate a Poltergeist haunting a homeowner who is a wits end. Poltergeistal activity in the home is terrorizing the tenant and paranormal investigators Bex and Sean are about to start the exorcism of this demonic entity away for good.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Haunted and Cursed Magpie Mines
programme.desc: Haunted Magpie Mines are located in the Peak District of Derbyshire. Believed to be one of the most paranormal mines in the UK. Will a ghost be caught on camera? and will any of the paranormal equipment make contact with the spirit world?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: The Lady in Grey
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate claims of a ghost lady in grey haunting Windleshaw abbey, St Helens, Merseyside. Over 600 years old and with new paranormal encounters reported almost weekly. Bex and Sean attempt to make contact with the infamous lady in grey.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 1
programme.desc: Bex and Sean are joined by a special guest as they investigate an abandoned home full of spirits in Liverpool.
programme.sub-title: Soul Less House of Ghosts - Part 1

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: My Boyfriend Beat Up My Mom
programme.desc: Kendra is on a mission to save herself from her toxic boyfriend Chris. At 17, Kendra is pregnant with his sixth child. Kendra has tried almost everything including kicking him out of their house, but he not only argued back but assaulted Kendra as well.
programme.sub-title: My Boyfriend Beat Up My Mom

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Over the Edge
programme.desc: Sheroya is 17 and struggling to raise 2 kids while trying to party all the time. Her boyfriend Malcolm frequently cheats and verbally abuses her. Steve’s got a lot of work ahead with this couple, but will either of them wake up?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Failed 5 Times?
programme.desc: Did Everett touch his girlfriend Michelle’s daughter? Her ex Robert says that his 7-year-old daughter said so. Everett will take a lie detector test to disprove it! Don’t miss these shocking results!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I’m Not the Man You Think I Am
programme.desc: Sean says his wife has made him so angry that he’s put her in the hospital over 10 times. Sean’s also got a secret of his own — he is really a she! Can Steve help Sean iron out his issues?
programme.sub-title: I’m Not the Man You Think I Am

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Real Teens: Real Topics
programme.desc: Steve’s hosting another teen girl town hall to address critical issues all teen girls could face, including drug use, physical abuse, and online predators. No question is off limits!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Rescues a Runaway
programme.desc: Sherry was attacked at 15 and ran away from home. She wants Steve’s help with reuniting her with her mother. Then, Dawn's teenage daughter Cathy recently gave birth, but lives in fear of the baby’s unemployed and unstable father Nick.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Look What You Did to Your Baby
programme.desc: Kristy wants her baby back from her mother Donna! Donna claims she took the baby away because he was born with severe disabilities due to Kristy’s drug use during pregnancy. Who’s the liar?
programme.sub-title: Look What You Did to Your Baby

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Teen Mom Murderer?
programme.desc: At 17, Janelle's infant son died from serious injuries. She was sentenced to 3 years in prison for reckless homicide, but claims she's innocent. What will her polygraph results say?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: A Shocking Betrayal
programme.desc: Korey is positive that his girlfriend Dominique is cheating on him and is also worried that she might be selling sex. She says that his suspicions have caused him to become abusive. Then, Gregory thinks that his girlfriend Robin isn’t faithful!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Did It To Hurt You
programme.desc: Aeshia’s here to prove to Terrence and his wife Lashondra that Terrence is the father of her child, but Lashondra knows she’s wrong! Both Shaunah and Chris have convinced themselves that they’re being cheated on. Who’s the father?
programme.sub-title: I Did It To Hurt You

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Left You, But You Are The Father
programme.desc: Anastasia and Robert's 2 year relationship crumbled when he heard rumors that she was cheating on him. She says that she's always been faithful, but Robert doesn't believe her and now he doubts he is the father of her newborn baby.
programme.sub-title: I Left You, But You Are The Father

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did The Babysitter Abuse My Child?
programme.desc: Stephanie says that ever since she came home from work to find her 1-year-old with a black eye, she has feared that her children's babysitter harms them. Sitter Cheryl denies some serious accusations about a child.
programme.sub-title: Did The Babysitter Abuse My Child?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: We Can't Live Like This
programme.desc: Thornton says he can't trust his cheating girlfriend Crystal and wants her to take a lie detector test! Plus, Stephanie wants to prove to her husband Mathew that she's not having sex with her own family member! She wants the accusations put to rest.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm Raising Him, But Is He Mine?
programme.desc: Deshawn claims that his ex Lynette abandoned their 5-year-old son. But she claims that he is keeping her from their child. However, Deshawn recently found out that he isn't listed on his son's birth certificate, so he wants a DNA test!
programme.sub-title: I'm Raising Him, But Is He Mine?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Know About the Affair, But Is He the Father?
programme.desc: Stephanie gave birth to a baby boy and believes Brandon is the father. But Brandon claims he didn't find out about the child until three years later and denies being the father. Stephanie and her mother want Brandon to step up.
programme.sub-title: I Know About the Affair, But Is He the Father?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Gets The Real Update
programme.desc: Megan wanted to find out if her boyfriend Devin was cheating. But even darker relationship secrets surface! Plus, you'll be shocked to find out why Laura and Steven need Steve's help again!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Falsely Accused of Molestation?
programme.desc: Desmond believes that his ex Cassandra is making up a story about him touching their child because she's jealous of his new fiancée. And later, Tammy has been investigated for child abuse and even accused of locking her kids in a closet.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?
programme.desc: Russell wants to put his family back together after his three children died in a fire. Next, Tatiana believes her 2-year-old nephew was abused. And she's accusing her sister's ex-fiancé Chris. Chris says he's not an abuser.
programme.sub-title: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: 13-Year-Old Father?
programme.desc: Curtis sat down with his mother Telisha, and told her that he is trying to have a baby but Telisha was shocked and terrified because Curtis is only 13 years old! Curtis insists he is ready to be a father.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: If I Don't Hit Her, She Doesn't Listen
programme.desc: Kelsey says her husband is abusing her. Malcolm believes that Kelsey has been cheating on him since the beginning and that their two kids may belong to another man. Plus, Carrie's boyfriend Chris thinks their child belongs to her ex.
programme.sub-title: If I Don't Hit Her, She Doesn't Listen

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Violated Me!
programme.desc: Monique wants to prove that Chris attacked her when he gave her a ride home after a party. But Chris denies any wrongdoing, and says Monique was too drunk to know what happened.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: She Said She'd Drown the Baby
programme.desc: Devon slipped into a coma and is on life support. But before he fell into a coma, he told his mother that his ex Alisha said he did not father their son. Alisha denies ever saying this and feels his whole family has turned their backs on her.
programme.sub-title: She Said She'd Drown the Baby

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Cheaters Come Clean
programme.desc: Couples reveal they have been cheating on today's Jerry Springer Show. Candice confronts Nikki for sleeping with her man and Mike suspects Moon has been cheating with two people.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Heidi kommer på Spencer med bartendern Stacie på en nattklubb och kräver att de ska gå i parterapi. Lauren riskerar sitt goda rykte när hon rekommenderar att People's Revolution ska ta in Stephanie som praktikant.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina försöker kommer över Justin genom att lägga ögonen på Brody. Heidi tvingar med sig Spencer på parterapi och när Stephanie strular till det på People´s Revolution hotar Lauren med att säga upp henne.

programme.title: The Hills: I Always Had A Little Crush
programme.desc: Audrina försöker komma över Justin genom att haka upp med Brody när flickorna krascha pojkarnas surfa resa till Hawaii. Heidis jungfru ex-pojkvän kommer på besök och hon hoppas några av hans värderingar kommer att smitta av sig på Spencer.
programme.sub-title: I Always Had A Little Crush

programme.title: The Hills: Playmates Bring the Drama
programme.desc: Audrinas hjärta krossas när Brodys flickvän konfronterar henne med frågor om Hawaii och Brody gör ingenting för att stoppa henne. Heidi läser ett sms från Stacie till Spencer och drar till en nattklubb för att konfrontera henne.

programme.title: The Hills: Keep Your Enemies Closer
programme.desc: Justin konfronterar Audrina om att hon strulade med Brody på Hawaii. Stephanie förstör en fotografering på jobbet och Lauren ställs till svars inför Kelly. Bartendern Stacie försöker att bli sams med Heidi.

programme.title: The Hills: Father of The Bride
programme.desc: Spencer försöker att rädda förhållandet med Heidi genom att be hennes far om hennes hand. Lauren tvingas att avskeda Stephanie från People's Revolution - vilket riskerar att förstöra deras vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: Hi Lauren, It's Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren är tveksam om hon ska gå på Heidis bröllop efter det att Spencer äntligen bett om ursäkt. Brody vägrar att riskera vänskapen med Jayde för att rädda förhållandet med Audrina - och Stephanie konfronterar Kelly Cutrone.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Old, Something New
programme.desc: I Laurens sista avsnitt måste hon bestämma sig för om hon kan förlåta Spencer och stötta Heidi på hennes prinsessbröllop. Alla är där - och blir chockerade när en oväntad gäst dyker upp.

programme.title: The Hills: It's On Bitch
programme.desc: Kristin startar krig när hon flörtar med Justin framför näsan på Audrina. Trots att de letar ny bostad tillsammans köper Spencer en utan att Heidi godkänt det.

programme.title: The Hills: Mess With Me, I Mess With You
programme.desc: Efter att Audrina struntat i henne, beslutar sig Kristin för att inte kämpa emot att hon är så attraherad av Justin. Heidi erbjuder sig att sitta barnvakt åt grannen, men Spencer vill inte ha nåt med barn att göra.
programme.sub-title: Mess With Me, I Mess With You

programme.title: The Hills: Strike One
programme.desc: Kristin får känna på hur det är att vara i ett förhållande med Justin när han aldrig dyker upp på Brodys överraskningsfest. Heidi och Spencer är inte överens om när de ska skaffa barn, och Audrina går på dejt med Justins bäste vän.

programme.title: The Hills: Old Habits Die Hard
programme.desc: Kristin tror att hon har tämjt Justin, men han har kanske inte kommit över Audrina än. När Holly ballar ur på ett event så tvingas Heidi ta upp hennes alkoholproblem med sin syster.

programme.title: The Hills: Sorry Boo, Strike Two
programme.desc: Justin spelar svårfångad med Kristin, men hans plan går i stöpet. Hollys supande gör att Heidi och Stephanie ordnar en intervention. Brody och Jayde börjar slåss och tvingas tänka över sin vänskap.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Justin hamnar på hal is efter det att Kristin och Audrina till slut träffats. Det enda Heidi vill ha i födelsedagspresent är en bebis, men Spencer har siktet inställt på nåt helt annat.

programme.title: The Hills: On To The Next
programme.desc: Kristin och Brody funderar på att börja dejta igen, men när de träffar Jayde inser de att tidpunkten är fel. Audrina och Justin diskuterar sin framtid, men det slutar inte som hon hoppats. Spencer tar till drastiska metoder mot Heidis bebisdrömmar.

programme.title: The Hills: Can't Always Get What You Want
programme.desc: Kristin och Jayde hamnar i bråk när hon försöker att få tillbaka Brody. Heidi planerar att bli gravid vare sig Spencer vill det eller inte, och Audrina bearbetar det faktum att Justin fortfarande har känslor för Kristin.
programme.sub-title: Can't Always Get What You Want

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. Right Now
programme.desc: Kristin vill inte bli ihop med Justin, men han ger sig inte utan kamp och Audrina gör slut med Justin för gott. Brody får kalla fötter när Jayde vill flytta in hos honom och Spencer har ångest över att Heidi kan vara gravid.

programme.title: The Hills: The Boys Of Summer
programme.desc: Kristin och Justin tar förhållandet till nästa nivå och Spencer konfronterar Heidi om gravtestet. Brody kanske fortfarande hyser känslor för Kristin efter det att Jayde talat ut om deras förhållande på en förlovningsfest.

programme.title: The Hills: Put On A Happy Face
programme.desc: Det blir inte roligt för Heidi att komma hem när mamma ogillar att hon gjort plastikkirurgi. Kristin och tjejerna åker till Miami för Super Bowl-helgen, men resan går snett när hennes festande börjar oroa Audrina, Lo och Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Rumor Has It
programme.desc: När det börjar gå rykten om Kristins festande får Stephanie skulden. Audrina börjar dejta en ny kille, men det hindrar inte Brody från att jaga henne. Spencer blir upprörd när han springer på Stephanie på Kristins fest.

programme.title: The Hills: The Elephant In The Room
programme.desc: Heidi har fest för sin granne, men festen hamnar i skymundan när Spencer blir arg på Holly. Kristin tycker att Audrina ska vara med Ryan och försöker sen komma närmare Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: This Is Goodbye
programme.desc: Heidis och Spencers beteende tvingar deras vänner och familjer att göra ett svårt val. Kristin och Brody får ihop det, men båda vill hellre vara singel. Ryan gör Audrina besviken när han aldrig dyker upp trots att de ska gå ut.

programme.title: The Hills: A New Bird
programme.desc: Brody riskerar sin vänskap med Kristin när han börjar gå ut med en ny tjej. Lo ordnar en dubbeldejt åt Stephanie. Ryan ger Audrinas vänner en ny chans.

programme.title: The Hills: Ghost From The Past
programme.desc: Kristin har svårt att gå vidare från Brody. Audrina råkar på Justin och börjar tveka över sitt förhållande med Ryan. Lo slår upp en bekantskap med Brodys nya flickvän.

programme.title: The Hills: The Company You Keep
programme.desc: Brodys nya kärlek gör Kristin till sin fiende när hon tar med en gammal rival till Kristins fest. Ryan kommer hem från turnén, men Audrina berättar inte att hon träffade Justin medan han var bortrest.

programme.title: The Hills: Break-Up to Make-Up
programme.desc: I samma veva som Audrina gör slut med Ryan överraskar Justin henne på födelsedagen. McKaelas vän Allie ställer till mer bråk för Kristin. Brody säger ett sanningens ord till Justin.

programme.title: The Hills: Welcome to the Jungle
programme.desc: När hela gruppen åker till Costa Rica för att surfa gör blir Brody svartsjuk när Kristin får ihop det med en bartender. Audrina försöker förneka sin attraktion till Justin, och Stephanie passar inte in i djungelmiljön.

programme.title: The Hills: Loves Me Not
programme.desc: Kristin och Brody talar ut och hon berättar att hon vill att de försöker på nytt. Heidis mamma besöker LA i hopp om en återförening. Lo och hennes pojkvän firar årsdag, och Stephanie börjar dejta en ny kille.

programme.title: The Hills: All Good Things...
programme.desc: Kristin står inför ett stort beslut som även påverkar Brody. Audrina gör slut med Justin. Lo vet inte om hon är redo för nästa steg med sin pojkvän och Stephanie tror att hon äntligen funnit den rätte.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Hold Grudges... JK!
programme.desc: En nystart för detta kompisgäng när de återvänder till The Hills och träffar varann för första gången på länge. De ställs inför nya utmaningar, men gamla rivaliteter och romanser ställer till det. Ibland är det förflutna inte förflutet.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Not My Family
programme.desc: Stephanie försöker att lappa ihop sin relation med brodern Spencer, Mischa säger ifrån till Perez Hilton som mobbade henne när hon var i stjärnljuset. Det slår gnistor mellan Audrina och Justin, men Justin verkar ha fått ögonen på en till.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: A Legend in His Own Mind
programme.desc: Audrina får veta nåt chockerande om Justin Bobby som får henne att tvivla på hans motiv. Det går hett till när Spencer och Heidi ifrågasätter sin vänskap med Brody. Samtidigt har Brandon Thomas Lee poolfest hos sin mamma.
programme.sub-title: A Legend in His Own Mind

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Audrina konfronterar Justin när han förnekar att han kysst henne. Brody funderar över sina relationer till sin far Caitlyn och vän Spencer. Spencer och Heidi försöker få verksamheten att växa vilket sätter deras förhållande på prov.
programme.sub-title: Not to Eavesdrop, But to Eavesdrop

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: Playing with Fire
programme.desc: Gänget åker till Vegas för att se Brodys DJ-uppträdande, och Justin hamnar mitt i en uppgörelse mellan Audrina och Stephanie. En skogsbrand härjar i Malibu, och Kaitlynn fruktar för Brodys liv när han stannar i evakueringszonen.

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends
programme.desc: Brody och Kaitlynn får se förödelsen efter bränderna i Malibu. Audrina fattar ett svårt beslut som gäller Justin. Under tiden går Mischa på en viktig audition och Heidi börjar återuppliva sin popstjärnekarriär.
programme.sub-title: I Don't Think We Can Be Friends

programme.title: The Hills: New Beginnings: You're Enemy #1
programme.desc: Skvallret tar fart och rykten sprids efter en incident med Brody och Stephanie. Audrina får en chock när Justin tar med en snygg tjej på middagen.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Marty The Meddler
programme.desc: Klorna är ute när alla åker på safari och Dean känner sin status som alfahanne hotad. Marty lägger sig i Chloes och Sams förhållande och John har händerna fulla med Georgia.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Love Is In The Air
programme.desc: Terrorpaddan får fnatt och skickar Marty och Sam på en dejt. En nykomling får tvillingarna att strida medan Georgia och Johns förhållande bara blir starkare.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: #Ballininbalifinale
programme.desc: Strandpartyt på Bali får ett dramatiskt slut när den sista ankomsten skapar kaos i villan. Georgia och John faller vid sista hindret, och Chloe får till slut lite action från Sam.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Welcome to the Peak
programme.desc: 10 dokusåpakändisar kommer till ett vinterparadis för att se om de kan hitta någon ny att vintermysa med. Vad de inte vet är att deras ex kommer att dra in som en lavin.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Winter Un-Wonderland
programme.desc: Callums och Nicoles ex orsakar stora problem i fjällstugan. Ett par får snabbt kontakt och ett annat förlorar kontakten. Ett nytt ex dyker upp och första heta dejten delas ut.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Caught Red Velvet Handed
programme.desc: Daniel gör ett trevande försök att få kontakt. Värmen stiger i bastun för en singel som kör dubbelt. Första exet åker ut ur fjällstugan.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Boo Years Eve!
programme.desc: Marlons ex blir varse en hemlighet. Två singlar blir konkurrenter om samma ex. Det hettar till på isceremonin när ett ex gör ett oväntat drag.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: The Bird Has Landed
programme.desc: Georgias och Callums relation prövas när det ex de har fasat för dyker upp. Det blir heta känslor över La Demis senaste kärleksintresse. En romantisk dejt delas ut.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: SOS, Save Our Singles
programme.desc: Singlarna får en chock, och måste se upp på Isceremonin. Allies och Nialls nyckfulla relation ställer till det för Allie.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Ex-Cuzzi
programme.desc: En perfekt dejt förvandlas till mardröm för ett av paren. Niall får seriös konkurrens om Allie. Marlon och La Demi brottas med sin situation.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Mums the Word
programme.desc: Georgia och Callum möter sina hårdaste kritiker. Marlon hamnar i kläm när ett ex kommer och hotar hans relation med La Demi. Isceremonin får en oväntad vändning.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Don't Say Soulmate
programme.desc: En nyanländ på toppen innebär en överraskning för stugans guldpar. En ny kontakt och ett förvånande beslut under dejten får Tyranny att se rött.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Adore-able Mess
programme.desc: Adore tripp till bastun hotar hennes romans med Tyler. Ett nytt ex ger efterlängtad distraktion. La Demis attityd mot sitt ex gör att hennes vänner sviker henne på Isceremonin.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Breaking Winter Balls
programme.desc: Adore tvingas välja mellan sitt ex och sin nästa, och en av dem blir svartsjuk. En het dejt skapar osämja och gör att nån får hjärtesorg.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Liar, Liar, Chalet on Fire
programme.desc: Ett chockerande lögndetektortest skapar kaos i huset, och ett starkt par förlorar tron på sitt förhållande. Georgia får till slut veta sanningen om Callum och Paris.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Peak of Love: Say Yes to the Next
programme.desc: Sanningsceremonin rör om i stugan och paren bestämmer hur de vill sluta. En singel ställer frågan, och för en annan blir sanningen för mycket att ta.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bobby's Dilemma
programme.desc: Den nya jakten på kärleken börjar på Mexikos stränder. Societetstjejen Daisy från Chelsea hugger tag i Aaron, och Essexgrabben Bobby lägger in en stöt på Rhianne, men kan det första exet hälla grus i maskineriet?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Dejtandet fortsätter, och Bobby och Bayley umgås på tu man hand. Arron får sikte på nya mål, men kommer han att överge Daisy? Tre nya deltagare skakar om villan, och nån måste åka därifrån.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Heartbreak And Happiness
programme.desc: Aaron tar avstånd från Daisy, men kan han vinna över Dominika? Ett nytt ex anländer och hotar att förstöra Bobbys och Bayleys relation.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Double Departure
programme.desc: Bobby blir övergiven av Bayley, och Daisy plockar gärna upp spillrorna. Aaron fortsätter jaga Dominika, en VIP-gäst skakar om huset, och ett par måste åka hem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Daisy's Disaster
programme.desc: Kommer ett nytillskott att innebära lycka för Josiah? Daisy drabbas dubbelt när hennes ex Mattys känslor för Natalee gör att hennes vänskap med tjejerna förstörs.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Bobby's Revenge
programme.desc: En ny ankomst innebär problem för George, och Bobby kan hämnas. Natalee vill ha grönt ljus från Daisy att satsa på Matty, och Aaron kanske leker med elden.
